title: Felix Drawing Library
features:
BoxESP (Works with OBS Hidden) So you can stream and record gameplay without your viewers/audience know you are cheating!

There are other features, but are less important like:

Roundify
Rainbowify (WIP)
HidePlayerUI (For cinematic shots) -- AntiCheats can ban you for this so be careful
ShowPlayerUI  -- AntiCheats can ban you for this so be careful
script:
local lib = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/I2345/FelixDrawinglib/main/main.lua', true))()

--[[

 DOCUMENTATION

local lib = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/I2345/FelixDrawinglib/main/main.lua', true))()

lib:BoxESP() -- Enables BoxESP
lib:ShowPlayerUi() -- Shows PlayersUI
lib:HidePlayerUI() -- Hides PlayersUI
lib:UnRoundiy(frame) -- unRoundifys a frame
lib:Rainbowify(item) -- Makes the item rainbow(wip)
lib:Roundify(frame, radius) -- Makes the frame round, (radius is how round)
]]--
